FN-768WZV-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 179
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative James Lomax
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/03/2023
House Bill 179as introduced would decrease receipts to the State General Fund by an estimated
$58,000 annually and correspondingly increase disbursements to the Alabama Association of
Ambulance Services and the Alabama EMS Association by an estimated $29,000 annually,
respectively, by revising the distribution of proceeds of sales of distinctive motor vehicle license
plates to emergency medical services providers, as provided by this bill.
